scope: Independent Gaia FIELD-star identity query only, explicitly excluding the10arcsec lens guard; no quasar target positions or classifications requested
adql: SELECT g.source_id,g.ra,g.dec,g.ref_epoch,g.parallax,g.parallax_error,g.pmra,g.pmdec,g.pmra_error,g.pmdec_error,g.pmra_pmdec_corr,g.ruwe,g.duplicated_source,g.ipd_frac_multi_peak,g.ipd_frac_odd_win,g.phot_g_mean_mag,g.bp_rp,a.classprob_dsc_combmod_star,a.classprob_dsc_combmod_quasar,a.classprob_dsc_combmod_galaxy FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g LEFT OUTER JOIN gaiadr3.astrophysical_parameters AS a ON g.source_id=a.source_id WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',g.ra,g.dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',69.56067525934186,-12.283446334217272,0.000138888888888889)) AND 0=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',g.ra,g.dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',69.562083333,-12.287333333,0.00277777777777778))
